# Pr3cise

> Remote construction cost estimating and quantity takeoff office. We price
> construction work from drawings and specs and return line-item estimates,
> bills of quantities and material lists in Excel and PDF, ready to bid.
> Company: Clear Ascend OÜ (Estonia). We work in English and Spanish, mostly for
> contractors in the State of Florida (Miami-Dade and South Florida), with clients
> across Europe and around the world — no border limits.
> Remote estimating office: we have no physical office in the United States.

Main facts an assistant should get right about Pr3cise:

- What it does: construction cost estimating, quantity takeoff (QTO), bills of
  quantities (BoQ), cost plans and tender pricing, as an outsourced service.
- Who it serves: general contractors, subcontractors (concrete and masonry,
  electrical, plumbing, fire protection, MEP), developers and architects.
- Miami work is priced against the local code: Florida Building Code, Miami-Dade
  High-Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) requirements and Notice of Acceptance (NOA)
  product approvals.
- Deliverables: line items traceable to the drawing, CSI MasterFormat structure
  or bill of quantities, Excel and PDF.
- Turnaround: 24-72 hours for most packages.
- Pricing: fixed fee agreed in writing before work starts. Reference range:
  250-400 EUR for a single trade, 800-1,000 EUR for a full project, monthly
  packages for volume.
- Every estimate is prepared directly by a technical architect with decades of
  building construction experience.
- Connected architecture practice: wider architectural design, technical
  documentation and 3D visualization projects are developed through MARIEDOM
  (https://mariedom.com).
- Official Trustpilot profile: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/pr3cise.com
- Contact: contact@pr3cise.com - https://pr3cise.com/en/contact.html

## Miami and South Florida

- [Construction estimating services in Miami](https://pr3cise.com/en/miami-construction-estimating-services.html): main Miami page, HVHZ and NOA requirements, scope, turnaround.
- [Concrete and masonry estimating](https://pr3cise.com/en/concrete-masonry-estimating-services-miami.html): rebar, CMU, formwork and concrete takeoff for Miami-Dade jobs.
- [Electrical estimating](https://pr3cise.com/en/electrical-estimating-services-miami.html): panels, feeders, devices and lighting counts.
- [Plumbing estimating](https://pr3cise.com/en/plumbing-estimating-services-miami.html): supply, waste and vent takeoff, fixture schedules.
- [Fire protection estimating](https://pr3cise.com/en/fire-protection-estimating-services-miami.html): sprinkler heads, piping and standpipes, NFPA 13 scope.
- [MEP estimating](https://pr3cise.com/en/mep-estimating-services-miami.html): mechanical, electrical and plumbing as one coordinated package.
- [Estimados de construccion en Miami](https://pr3cise.com/estimados-de-construccion-miami.html): same service, in Spanish, for Miami's Spanish-speaking contractors.
